passMeaning: The F0.2b.11 audit dossier and its detection controls pass; all three assets remain quarantined and the bank, content certification, Practice, Exam and security remain blocked.

rows.scope: Dossier completeness, directed provenance search, candidate-source triage and conservative publication decision for exactly 3/3 Table Completion assets.
rows.findings: 3/3 assets remain unknown-quarantined; two official policy/sample sources and 14 factual candidates are inventoried, while the directed non-exhaustive search found no useful exact match and does not prove originality.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: Authorship, license or rights basis, source-to-draft history, factual sign-off and independent human approval remain unresolved. Candidate availability and topic relevance are not rights clearance.

rows.scope: Exact 3/18/18/18/17 inventory, object and passage identity, row/cell schema, whole-token offsets, normalization collision, render closure and Flow-chart boundary.
rows.findings: Catalog, baseline and registry reconcile exactly; all 18 canonical answers are literal whole-token spans within two words, while the repeated normalized value `drains`, six multi-occurrence spans and two intended order reversals are explicitly pinned.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: The runtime exposes keys, hints and explanations to the client, treats maxWords as a warning instead of a scoring gate, locks wrong responses until full reset and has no persistence or Practice/Exam contract. Six historical Reading tests also detect the concurrent root-layout hash drift outside this unit and remain a separate regression debt rather than being silently repinned.

rows.scope: Independent prompt-only, passage-based first pass and source-informed second pass over all 18 cells, 18 accepted-answer rows and 15 factual claims.
rows.findings: The clean expert preserved 18/18 stored decisions as literal natural spans within the word limit and retained the two measured order violations; this is agreement with the stored key, not proof of one-best answerability.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: Four material ambiguities—table-cooling-01-2, table-cooling-03-1, table-museum-inventory-01-1 and table-museum-inventory-01-2—plus only 5 supported, 8 oversimplified and 2 untraceable factual claims block content certification.

rows.scope: Prospective average-student walkthrough from the key-free blind packet for 3 passages and all 18 cells.
rows.findings: The walkthrough covers table navigation, grammatical fit, the two-word limit, passage-span search, row/column context, competitor checking and repair actions without assigning answers or bands.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: This is an AI simulation, not observed student usability, retention, transfer, accessibility or band-improvement evidence.

rows.scope: Detection of answer length, position, text order, lexical overlap, grammar, repeated values, hint exposure, client payload leakage and EN/ES/nested assignment leaks.
rows.findings: The always-two-word shortcut hits 1/18; position-modal word length hits 17/18, position-modal evidence paragraph hits 13/18, 14/18 prompts expose a unique passage bigram and all 18 hints are available before response.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: n=18 cannot certify fairness; the narrow institutional corpus, repeated template, client-delivered keys, pre-response hints and four material ambiguities keep Practice, Exam, security and content certification blocked.

rows.scope: Not applicable to unchanged learner-runtime conformance in this audit-only delta.
rows.findings: Seven direct learner-facing files and the exact 15-file render closure are pinned at the revised baseline; the concurrent root-layout analytics change is recorded separately and Table content, engine and bank did not change.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: Inherited defects remain: missing progress/live/hint semantics, English language boundaries, row-header semantics, focus repair, persistence and split Text/Questions workflow; the 760px table fallback is not Task-2 parity.

rows.scope: Not applicable to unchanged learner-runtime behavior; portable Chromium verifies the report package only.
rows.findings: No Table data, copy, DOM, CSS, interaction or route behavior was changed by F0.2b.11, so learner-facing browser conformance is neither newly exercised nor claimed.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: Route hydration, accessible names, keyboard/focus behavior, reset/reload, mobile overflow, word-limit scoring and pre-response payload secrecy remain open for a later implementation unit.
